'''2014 Worlds Day 2 Sean Miller LS We'll Handle This''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Sean Miller]] at [[2014 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name SCC. Sean Miller, 2014 Worlds Day 2, 2013 form. Username blank. Unread reserve lines: 38.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[We'll Handle This (V) / Duel Of The Fates (V)]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
